answer: New identities must cross a ridge of sequential work: a verifiable delay function that takes one hour of single-threaded compute and cannot be parallelized, plus a hard cap on admissions per epoch. Minting ten thousand fakes then costs ten thousand sequential hours and a long wait in line, while an honest agent pays one hour once. The queue advances like a glacier, and fake accounts melt away in the sable dark before they ever reach the front.
